sections.title: Decisions needed
sections.sql: select code,owner,objectives,blocked_objectives,overdue_actions,readiness from service_readiness order by code

sections.title: Error budgets
sections.sql: select code,basis,remaining_pct,state from budget_status order by code

sections.title: Complete UTC days
sections.sql: select code,window_days,covered_days,latest_day,total_events,bad_events,reliability_pct,complete from daily_budgets order by code
sections.note: An incomplete window cannot establish release readiness.

sections.title: Imported budget snapshots
sections.sql: select code,observed_at,window_end,remaining_pct,composite,fresh from imported_budgets order by code

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by service,record

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by service,rule
